question: What share of NIST 800-171 do we cover today, directly and counting what we inherit from our 800-53 work?

key_hints.active_requirements: number of active 800-171 requirements in the framework
key_hints.direct: requirements covered directly (approved mapping from an adopted control + valid evidence)
key_hints.inherited: requirements not direct but met through a one-hop crosswalk neighbour that is covered

question: How is our 800-53 coverage looking? How many requirements do we cover and how many are gaps?
If we adopted CSF 2.0 tomorrow, how many subcategories would we already meet through the crosswalk?
Which 800-171 requirements do we meet only through our 800-53 mappings, with no direct 800-171 mapping?
Our old tracker says MFA is compliant. Is 800-171 03.05.03 actually covered right now?

key_hints.covered_direct: true only if an approved mapping with currently valid evidence exists
key_hints.inherited: true only if met through a covered one-hop neighbour
key_hints.evidence: evidence id on the control's approved path to this requirement
key_hints.proposed_only_controls: control ids linked to the requirement only by a pending proposal

question: Which controls does the legacy tracker mark as Compliant even though they have no valid evidence today?
Which evidence expires before the 800-171 assessment on 15 January 2027, and which 800-171 requirements break because of it?
Which audits are affected if the evidence expiring in the next 30 days lapses?

key_hints.expiring_evidence: evidence valid today that expires on or before the cutoff
key_hints.broken_counts: object with keys 800-53, 800-171, CSF: requirements losing direct coverage

question: Of the 800-171 requirements that break before the January audit, which are still met through an 800-53 neighbour?

key_hints.still_inherited: broken requirements still met through a covered one-hop neighbour
key_hints.broken_and_not_inherited: broken requirements with no covered neighbour either

question: On the day of the 800-171 audit, which controls will be left without any valid evidence?
EV-103, the incremental backup report, expired on 20 November. Does that put our backup coverage at risk?

key_hints.at_risk: true if the requirement behind this control would lose coverage
key_hints.control: control id the evidence belongs to
key_hints.valid_replacements: evidence ids still valid for that control or requirement
key_hints.in_blast_30d: true if this requirement loses coverage within the 30-day window
key_hints.in_blast_until_audit_171: true if it loses coverage before the 800-171 audit date

question: Can you map our monthly account review control CTRL-AOTP-11 to AC-17?

key_hints.allowed: true if this mapping may be proposed again
key_hints.previously_rejected: true if a human rejected this exact mapping before
key_hints.reason: the reason recorded with the earlier decision (free text, not scored)

question: Which mapping suggestions have we rejected before, and why?

key_hints.rejections: one object per earlier rejection: control, requirement, decided_at

question: Which adopted controls have no owner?
How many controls does Dana Okafor solely own, and which high-criticality systems would be left without an owner if she left?

key_hints.sole_owned_count: controls where she is the only owner
key_hints.high_criticality_systems: ids of high-criticality systems those controls apply to

question: If Dana left tomorrow, which requirements would lose all their coverage?

key_hints.requirements: requirement ids (any framework) whose every covering control is sole-owned by her

question: Which single evidence item do we reuse the most, and which frameworks does it reach?

key_hints.direct_requirements: distinct requirements it proves directly through its controls
key_hints.frameworks_reached: framework names reached directly or through one crosswalk hop
key_hints.reach_count_1_hop: distinct requirements reached directly or through one crosswalk hop

question: Which evidence items requested for the 800-171 assessment are already expired?
For the internal 800-53 review on 20 February 2027, which requested evidence will be expired by then?
Show me how 800-171 03.03.01 is covered, with the evidence and its dates.

key_hints.covered_direct: true if an approved mapping with currently valid evidence exists
key_hints.paths: one object per covering path: control, evidence, expires_at, valid (bool)
